summary: Completed 209 experiments in 1152 minutes. Efficiency was severely degraded by sequential execution (DualGPURunner unutilized, GPUs idle) and a massive 82-minute doomed-rerun block.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1603 (88 min): Energy-Based Constraint Network (EBCN) coherence sco
Exp 1663 (82 min): Doomed-rerun block gated on Exp 1662
Exp 1657 (57 min): KV260 EBRM Hardware Offload
Exp 1653 (53 min): NSVIF DSL SOTA GGUF Integration
bottlenecks_identified: Doomed-rerun block consuming 82 minutes for Exp 1663.
Complete lack of DualGPURunner utilization leaving both RTX 3090 GPUs idle (0% utilization).
Sequential execution of long-running hardware and integration experiments.
improvements_suggested: Implement fail-fast for doomed-rerun blocks to eliminate the 82-minute wait.
Deploy DualGPURunner for parallel execution across the two RTX 3090s.
Optimize sequential execution of long-running experiments like Exp 1603.
meta_reflection: Retrospective clearly identifies lack of parallelization as the primary operational gap, alongside ineffective failure caching.
